  [inst_6 : NormedAddCommGroup Y] [inst_7 : NormedSpace ℝ Y] [CompleteSpace Y],
  Breakdown.Periodic.SplitIntegralBound →
    ∀ (ΛT : ℝ → Z →L[ℝ] XT) (ΛR : ℝ → Z →L[ℝ] XR) (GT : XT →L[ℝ] Y) (GR : XR →L[ℝ] Y),
      (∀ (ζ : Z), ContinuousOn (fun τ => (ΛT τ) ζ) (Set.Ioi 0)) →
        (∀ (ζ : Z), ContinuousOn (fun τ => (ΛR τ) ζ) (Set.Ioi 0)) →
          ∀ {KT KR MT MR Cw Cx : ℝ},
            0 ≤ KT →
              0 ≤ KR →
                0 ≤ MT →
                  0 ≤ MR →
                    0 ≤ Cw →
                      0 ≤ Cx →
                        (∀ (τ : ℝ), 0 < τ → τ ≤ 1 → ‖ΛT τ‖ ≤ KT * τ ^ (-(3 / 4))) →
                          (∀ (τ : ℝ), 0 < τ → τ ≤ 1 → ‖ΛR τ‖ ≤ KR * τ ^ (-(3 / 4))) →
                            ‖GT‖ ≤ MT →
                              ‖GR‖ ≤ MR →
                                ∀ {w : ℝ → ℝ},
                                  Continuous w →
                                    (∀ (σ : ℝ), ‖w σ‖ ≤ Cw) →
                                      ∀ {x : ℝ → Z},
                                        Continuous x →
                                          (∀ (σ : ℝ), ‖x σ‖ ≤ Cx) →
                                            ∀ {u e ε a₀ : ℝ},
                                              0 ≤ u →
                                                0 ≤ e →
                                                  u ≤ 1 - e →
                                                    0 < ε →
                                                      0 ≤ a₀ →
                                                        (∀ σ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 u,
                                                            ε ≤ 1 - σ - e →
                                                              ‖GT ((ΛT (1 - σ - e)) (x σ)) -
                                                                    GR ((ΛR (1 - σ - e)) (x σ))‖ ≤
                                                                a₀) →
                                                          ∀ (fT fR : ℝ → Y),
                                                            (∀ (σ : ℝ), fT σ = w σ • GT ((ΛT (1 - σ - e)) (x σ))) →
                                                              (∀ (σ : ℝ), fR σ = w σ • GR ((ΛR (1 - σ - e)) (x σ))) →
                                                                ‖(∫ (σ : ℝ) in 0..u, fT σ) - ∫ (σ : ℝ) in 0..u, fR σ‖ ≤
                                                                  Cw * a₀ * u +
